summary: A parody virtual-pet firmware: you look after a cartoon Trump by feeding, praising, cleaning up after him and putting him to bed, and when he is happy he plays bongos along with your keyboard.
features: Four care keys: Feed, Praise, Clean and Rest
Food, Mood and Energy bars; Game Over when all reach zero
Five-minute days; time powered off does not count
Pentatonic keyboard with bongo accompaniment and voice clips
Effects knobs unused; no reverb or delay
Installs with a Python command-line tool; autosaves progress
